# ReportKit

> Framework-agnostic PHP report engine with Laravel adapters (4.1–13) and a CSS/JS UI pack.
> Product of Lorapok Labs — https://reportkit.lorapok.tech

## Packages
- reportkit/core — https://github.com/Maijied/Reportkit-Core/tree/main/reportkit-core
- reportkit/laravel — https://github.com/Maijied/Reportkit-Core/tree/main/reportkit-laravel
- reportkit/laravel-legacy — https://github.com/Maijied/Reportkit-Core/tree/main/reportkit-laravel-legacy
- @lorapok-labs/reportkit-ui — https://github.com/Maijied/Reportkit-Core/tree/main/reportkit-ui

## Docs
- https://reportkit.lorapok.tech/docs/0.1/getting-started/introduction
- https://reportkit.lorapok.tech/docs/0.1/multi-database/overview
